title: Entergy’s Louisiana utilities monitoring potential tropical weather
summary: Entergy Louisiana and Entergy New Orleans are closely monitoring the developing tropical system as it moves through the Gulf early this week.
body_markdown:
NEW ORLEANS – Entergy Louisiana


and Entergy New Orleans are


closely monitoring the developing tropical system as it moves through the Gulf early this week. Current forecasts indicate the disturbance will bring heavy rain and periods of gusty wind to parts of southwest Louisiana, with rainfall being the primary impact at this time.


Crews statewide are prepared and ready to respond should severe weather affect electric service and will do so safely and efficiently when conditions allow.


The companies encourage customers to take the time now to get personal storm plans in place and make a kit with the basic emergency supplies, including any medical needs that require electricity.


Learn more about how to make an emergency kit, get important severe weather safety tips and prepare for medical needs on the company’s


[Storm Center website](https://www.entergy.com/stormcenter) .


**Stay informed**


Staying informed before, during and after a tropical system strikes is just as important as making personal storm plans. Here’s how you can stay up-to-date on our preparations and restoration efforts:


- Download the


[Entergy app](https://www.entergy.com/app/) . Customers can use the app to report outages or check on the status of power at their home or business.


- Check Entergy’s


[View Outage map](http://www.entergy.com/viewoutages) . Maps show where outages are located and give information about restoration progress.


- Follow Entergy Louisiana on


[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/EntergyLA) and


[X](https://x.com/EntergyLA) and Entergy New Orleans on


[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/EntergyNOLA) and


[X](https://x.com/EntergyNOLA) . Social media also plays an important role in keeping you informed, and we place a high priority on updating our social media channels throughout an event.


- Text us: If you are signed up to receive our notifications, you can text OUT to 36778 to report an outage or STAT for the status of your power outage. To sign up for text messaging, go to


[myentergy.com](https://www.myentergy.com/s/) or text REG to 36778. Have your account number and ZIP code handy. The registration pattern is as follows, including spaces: REG (account number) (ZIP code).


- Visit the company’s


[Storm Center](https://www.entergy.com/stormcenter) website. The site has storm safety, preparation and restoration information that is updated throughout the day.


- Download the


[Operation: Storm Ready Guide](https://www.entergy.com/wp-content/uploads/StormReadyGuide.pdf) . This guide will help you plan and prepare for weather emergencies. Information is also available in


[Spanish](https://www.entergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026_StormReadyFlyer_ES.pdf) and


[Vietnamese](https://www.entergy.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/2026_StormReadyFlyer_VT.pdf) .


Following any impacts, check Entergy’s


[View Outage map](https://www.entergy.com/viewoutages) for the latest information about restoration progress.


**About Entergy Louisiana**
Entergy Louisiana provides electric service to more than 1.1 million customers in 58 parishes.


**About Entergy New Orleans**
Entergy New Orleans is an electric service that serves Louisiana’s Orleans Parish. The company provides electricity to more than 209,000 customers.


Both companies are subsidiaries of Entergy Corporation. Entergy produces, transmits and distributes electricity to power life for 3 million customers through our operating companies in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi and Texas. We’re investing for growth and improved reliability and resilience of our energy system while working to keep energy rates affordable for our customers. We’re also investing in cleaner energy generation like modern natural gas, nuclear and renewable energy. A nationally recognized leader in sustainability and corporate citizenship, we deliver more than $100 million in economic benefits each year to the communities we serve through philanthropy, volunteerism and advocacy. Entergy is a Fortune 500 company headquartered in New Orleans, Louisiana, and has approximately 12,000 employees.
